method.independence: Reviewer did not author Web or its organization repair. Earlier runtime authorship is disclosed; this assigned partition is Web, with supplemental read-only compatibility checks against changed runtime interfaces.
method.integrity: All 229 current Web files match both the round5 frozen manifest and the sealed round4 Web report. Supplemental runtime references also match the same round5 manifest. No silent rebind to later source.
method.coverage: Complete current production-boundary sweep of application/session/navigation, projects and organization, chat/history/models/provider selection, goals/queue/plans, files/Git/worktrees, tools/MCP/OAuth/settings, Root identity, terminals/processes/CLI/voice, rendering/mobile/menu, receipts and bounded browser storage. All Web tests/support/config/style structures checked.
method.inheritance: Unchanged body evidence is inherited per file from round4 and its explicit earlier baseline chain. Current full reads, selected bodies, boundary-only inspection and structure are distinguished. This is not a claim of a fresh uniform line-by-line read of all 229 files.
method.crossLayer: Fresh source tracing checked omitted/null native metadata through runtime normalization and current frontend rendering/admission. The compatibility observations are not additional alleged upstream-contract defects.
method.execution: No tests, tsc/build, browser, preview server, network workflow, deployment, paid inference or credentials were run/read this round. Static assertion bodies were inspected. Prior or author passing counts are not presented as fresh validation.
method.sourceWrites: None. Only ignored .work audit helper/report artifacts were created; prior sealed reports and original reproductions were not modified.

contractCompatibility.contract: remoteControl pairing omitted or null manualPairingCode
contractCompatibility.reasoning: Runtime registers only a present manual code; required main pairing code remains private owner read. UI conditionally renders the manual input and still shows pairingCode/expiry and status check when manualPairingCode is absent. Static Pairing type is narrower than runtime optionality but no unsafe required-field dereference exists.

Runtime deletes stale cwd and returns selectionReady false. Settings shows missing cwd as unprovided; picker disables it, reports any selected now-unready ID and blocks ordinary send through onProblem. No default cwd or local executor is silently substituted. Empty string is not treated as null/missing by this compatibility claim.
Runtime publishes explicit nextCursor null for omission; UI disables next page while preserving current clients. Existing cursor loop and 100-page bounds remain.

contractCompatibility.contract: account credit metadata/accountId omitted or null; summary.credits null
contractCompatibility.reasoning: Preview normalizes absent accountId/summary to null and redeemable false. UI uses optional summary and credits ?? [], distinguishes unavailable information from zero, disables consume without redeemable and disables email without accountId. A null credit list with valid count/identity still permits explicitly choosing the native next-available entitlement, consistent with runtime optional creditId.

contractCompatibility.contract: configuration positive acknowledgement followed by local failure
contractCompatibility.reasoning: The new error code retains delivery unknown in generic RpcError handling. Durable operation state stays unknown, generic extension actions remain disabled, and recovery only reads the existing identity. Only an explicit not_sent fact can release the unresolved operation. Accepted proof cannot be downgraded by a later unknown.

semanticCoverage.result: Current ProjectDialog normalization retains absolute/relative meaning, ./../ semantics, POSIX literal backslash and explicit user path. UTF-8/helper JSON budget precedes submission; defaults/Api/CSRF/epoch/UID/gate owners prevent stale handoff. Registered IDs remain filtered through repaired path-category comparison. Prior positive organization repair evidence is inherited unchanged.

Actual identity and readiness gates apply before native consumers; root/native drafts remain separate, unsaved drafts protect navigation. Server revision, rootAllowed and separate explicit restart/root consent gate switches. No implicit escalation or claim that sandbox changes UID.

Provider-qualified shared catalog and model defaults remain owner-scoped and bounded. Explicit resume/send/steer/queue/goal/branch/review controls retain distinct admission and completion behavior. History/timeline synchronization remains versioned and bounded; no automatic write retry.

Dedicated public-summary fields only; generic/raw reasoning is excluded before fallback. Completed final-answer copy and footer menu retain owner guards. Composer honors context/media/model/environment blockers. Responsive overflow/hidden rules and mobile interaction test structure were reviewed statically.

Secret handoffs stay connection-owned and volatile; explicit confirmations/version facts remain required. Settings, trust, MCP configuration, skills/plugins/import/share and approval boundaries keep original-receipt recovery and stale-owner guards. Nullable remote/account compatibility is traced separately above.

File versions/no-replace, explicit Git HEAD/index review, registered worktree origins and exact resource IDs remain. Terminal/CLI/process/voice lifecycle ownership, input/output limits, recovery and explicit close controls retain prior semantics.

Api persists intent before dispatch; delivery classification is generic and acceptance monotonic. Unknowns remain retained until explicit recovery/closure. Draft cleanup is revision-specific, bounded storage fails visibly, and receipt archives verify complete identity/digest before rotation.
